intro: My work moves from the map to the field and back. I started with land use change and watersheds in Ethiopia, and now build soil health benchmarks and soil carbon maps that respect local context.

themes.title: Context-aware soil health assessment
themes.summary: A soil health score is only useful if it compares a field with soils that could realistically be like it. I build benchmarks that account for climate, soil type, and management.

projects.title: SHAPE-SSA: Soil Health Assessment Protocol and Evaluation for Sub-Saharan Africa
projects.summary: Hierarchical Bayesian benchmarking of soil organic carbon by agroecological context. Published in Communications Earth & Environment (2026).

projects.title: SHAPE-BR: soil health assessment framework for Brazil
projects.partners: University of Florida and partners in Brazil
projects.summary: Extends the SHAPE approach to Brazilian soils and management systems. Published in Soil and Tillage Research.

projects.title: 4R nutrient stewardship and cover crops across the U.S. Corn Belt
projects.summary: Quantified how nutrient stewardship and cover cropping change soil health indicators across the Corn Belt.

themes.caption: SHAPE-SSA scores the same soil carbon value differently in highland, midland, and lowland soils. From Biru et al. (2026), Communications Earth & Environment, CC BY.

themes.title: Digital soil mapping and interpretable machine learning
themes.summary: Fewer, well-chosen predictors make soil maps easier to explain and to scale. I combine feature selection, machine learning, and uncertainty to map soil properties.

projects.title: Minimum interpretable predictor set (MIPS) for soil organic carbon mapping
projects.summary: Robust rank aggregation to select a compact covariate set. Published in Computers and Electronics in Agriculture (2026).

projects.title: 250 m soil organic carbon map of Ethiopia
projects.summary: Spatially validated national map with calibrated uncertainty and an area-of-applicability check.

projects.title: Multi-property digital soil mapping
projects.summary: Mapping several soil properties together to support soil health and nutrient decisions.

themes.caption: Soil organic carbon across Ethiopia at 250 m, with prediction uncertainty and area of applicability.

themes.title: Geonutrition: soil, grain, and human health
themes.summary: Micronutrient gaps in diets often start in the soil. I connect soil maps to crop nutrient content to show where interventions like zinc biofortification can work.

projects.title: Soil–grain–human health nexus
projects.summary: A geonutrition approach to addressing micronutrient deficiencies, presented at the UF Future of Food Forum (2024).

projects.title: Where does zinc biofortification work? A Bayesian G×E×M framework
projects.summary: Quantifies yield and grain zinc trade-offs in wheat across genotype, environment, and management.

themes.caption: Agroecological zones and soil sampling locations across Ethiopia.

themes.title: Land use, watersheds, and ecosystem services
themes.summary: Thirteen years of work in Ethiopia on how land use change reshapes erosion, water, and the services landscapes provide.

projects.title: Hydrological impacts of climate and land use change in the Guder watershed
projects.summary: Watershed-scale SWAT modeling and scenario analysis, with graduate student research.

projects.title: Soil contamination and organochlorine pesticide risk assessment
projects.summary: Combined laboratory analysis and spatial assessment of contamination risk on agricultural land.

projects.title: Land use change and hydrology of the Koga watershed (MSc)
projects.partners: Bahir Dar University, Geospatial Data and Technology Center
projects.summary: Multi-decade land cover change mapped from satellite imagery and linked to streamflow and erosion with ArcSWAT and SWAT-CUP.

themes.caption: Elevation across Ethiopia, the backbone of its land use and watershed patterns.

themes.title: Applied projects and capacity building
themes.summary: Projects with government and university partners that put geospatial tools in the hands of practitioners.

projects.title: Ambo University mega project on agricultural technology adoption
projects.summary: Multidisciplinary study of technology adoption, from field data collection to reporting.

projects.title: Urban land training and competency assessment
projects.partners: Ambo University, Ministry of Urban and Infrastructure
projects.summary: Capacity building, quality assurance, and certification for urban land professionals.

projects.title: Land information system training and cadastral curriculum review
projects.partners: Ministry of Urban and Infrastructure, URRPO, Ambo University
projects.summary: National training modules and workshops for land information and cadastral systems.
